senses.gloss:
m. (-विः)
1 The sun.
2 A mountain.
3 A sheep.
4 A master.
5 A blanket.
6 A rat.
7 A wall or enclosure.
8 Air, wind.
9 The shawl goat.
f. (-विः)
A woman in her courses; also अवी.
E.
अव to go, to preserve, &c. इन् aff.

f. (-वी)
A woman in her courses: see अवि.

f. (-वी)
Pain of child-birth.

n. (-कं)
A diamond.
E.
अवि the sun, &c. कन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Woollen, &c. or any thing relating to or derived from a sheep.
m. (-कः)
A blanket, woollen cloth.
E.
अवि a sheep, वुञ् aff.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
Closed, shut.
E.
अ neg. विकच open.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unblown.
E.
अ neg. विकचित blown.

m. (-टः)
A flock of sheep.
E.
अवि a sheep, कटच् aff.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Not boasting, not talking vainly or idly.
E.
अ, and विकथा boasting.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
One who does not boast.
n. (-नं)
Not boasting.
E.
अ neg. विकथन talking idly.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Entire, perfect, unimpaired.
2 Regular, orderly, consistent.
E.
अ, and विकल defective.

m. (-ल्पः)
Positive act or precept, absence of doubt or alternative.
E.
अ neg. विकल्प alternative.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Immutable, permanent.
E.
अ neg. विकार change.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Immutable, unchangeable.
E.
अ neg. विकार्य्य liable to change of form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unchanged, permanent.
E.
अ neg. विकृत changed.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Powerless, feeble.
m. (-मः)
Cowardice.
E.
अ neg. विक्रम prowess.

m. (-यः)
Want of sale.
E.
अ neg. विक्रय sale.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Unsurpassed.
2 Feeble, powerless.
E.
अ neg. वि before क्रम to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unsold.
E.
अ neg. विक्रीत sold.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Unsaleable, not to be sold.
E.
अ neg. विक्रेय to be sold.

m. (-मः)
Vigour, freshness, absence of fatigue.
E.
अ neg. विक्लम fatigue.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Calm, composed, firm.
E.
अ neg. विक्लव confounded.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Unwearied.
E.
अ neg. विक्लान्त wearied.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Entire, undiminished.
2 Unhurt.
E.
अ neg. विक्षत wounded.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Attentive, composed.
2 Retained.
E.
अ neg. विक्षिप्त tossed, agitated.

m. (-भः)
Quiet, quiescence.
E.
अ neg. विक्षोभ agitation.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tranquil, undisturbed.
E.
अ neg. विक्षोभित agitated.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Retained, present, unseparated.
E.
अ neg. विगत gone away.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Unseparated, unremoved.
m. (-मः)
Presence, inherence, association, non-separation.
E.
अ neg. विगम separation.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unreproached.
E.
अ neg. विगर्हित reproached.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unreproached.
E.
अ, and विगीत censure.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Compatible, consistent with, not contrary to.
2 Worthy, good.
E.
अ neg. वि without, गुण property.

m. (-ग्नः)
A fruit tree, commonly Caronda, (Carissa Carondas.)
E.
अ neg. विज to fear, part. past., irr.

m. (-ग्नः)
A small fruit tree, vulgarly Caronda, (Carissa carondas.) also अविग्न.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Bodiless, incorporeal.
E.
अ neg. विग्रह body.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं)
Unimpeded, uninterrupted.
E.
अ neg. विघ्न obstacle.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Unlearned, ignorant.
E.
अ neg. विचक्षण learned.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Undiscriminating, ill-judging, unwise.
2 Prompt, unhesitating.
m. (-रः)
1 Want of judgment or discrimination, error, folly.
2 Promptitude.
E.
अ neg. विचार discussion.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ill-judged or investigated, unconsidered.
2 Determined, certain, clear, not requiring deliberation.
E.
अ neg. विचारित discussed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Victorious, triumphant.
2 Unmoved.
E.
अ neg. विचालित shaken, resisted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Undeviated from, observed, followed.
2 Eternal, permanent.
E.
अ neg. विच्युत fallen.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Unseparated, undivided.
E.
अ neg. विछिन्न cut off.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Entire, whole, undivided.
2 Uninterrupted.
m. (-दः)
1 Entireness.
2 Connexion, continuity.
E.
अ neg. विछेद separation.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of the same species.
E.
अ neg. विजातीय of a different kind.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Clumsy, stupid.
2 Ignorant, untaught.
E.
अ neg. विज्ञ wise.

f. (-ता)
Ignorance, fully.
E.
अविज्ञ, and तल् affix; also अविज्ञत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unknown.
2 Undistinguished.
E.
अ, and विज्ञात known.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Undiscernible, not to be recognised or known.
E.
अ neg. विज्ञेय to be known.

n. (-नं)
A direct flight.
E.
अ neg. विडीन flying deviously.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Preserved, protected.
E.
अव to preserve, क्त affix of part. past.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Unknown.
2 Poor.
E.
अ neg. वित्त known, or wealth.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Passed, gone.
2 Placed, hung.
m. (-तः)
The sacrificial cord worn in any particular manner.
E.
आङ् before वीत gone.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
True.
n. (-थं)
Truth.
E.
अ neg. and वितथ untrue.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Quicksilver.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
Fit for or suited to a sheep.
E.
अवि and थ्यन् aff.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
1 Unlearned.
2 Stupid.
E.
अ neg. विदग्ध clever.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Imperfectly digested, producing heartburn.
E.
अ neg. वि free from, दाहिन् what burns.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unknown.
E.
अ neg. विदित known.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Near, contiguous.
E.
अ neg. विदूर distant.

ind.
Near, not far off.
E.
अविदूर and तसि aff.

n. (-सं)
The milk of a ewe.
E.
अवि and दूस aff.

f. (-र्णा-र्णी)
A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
अ neg. विद्ध broken, divided, and कर्ण the ear; the leaf being compared to the ear; also अविद्धकर्णी and विद्धकर्णी.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 Foolish, unwise.
2 Not relating to knowledge.
f. (द्या)
1 Ignorance.
2 Spiritual ignorance.
3 Illusion.
4 Personified illusion or Māyā.
E.
अ priv. and विद्या knowledge.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Non-existent.
2 Not present, absent.
E.
अ, and विद्यमान being.

mfn. (-द्वान्-टुषी-द्वः)
Unwise, unlearned.
E.
अ neg. विद्वस् learned.

n. (-नं)
Irregularity, deviation from or absence of fixed rule.
E.
अ, and विधान rule.

ind.
Irregularly.
E.
अविधान and तसि aff.

mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि)
Irregular, void of or contrary to rule.
f. (-धिः)
Irregularity.
E.
अ, and विधि rule.

m. (-नः)
A sacrificer, one who makes a sacrifice or causes it to be made.
E.
अव to preserve, इनच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Indecorous, ill-behaved^1.
m. (-यः)
1 Indecorum, impropriety, fault.
2 Incivility, disrespect.
3 Offence, crime.
E.
अ, and विनय modest behaviour.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Indestructible: so अविनाश्य.
E.
अ neg. विनश्वर destructible.

m. (-वः)
Inherent and essential character.
E.
अ, and विना without, भाव property.

m. (-मः)
An illogical conclusion.
E.
अ neg. विनिगम accurate deduction.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति)
Holding on, advancing, one who does not turn back.
E.
अ neg. विनिवर्त्तिन् who retreats.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Without an exception.
E.
अ neg. विनिर्मोक exception.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Misbehaving, acting ill or improperly, wicked, vile.
f. (-ता)
An unchaste or disloyal woman.
E.
अ neg. विनीत virtuous.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Unopposed, having no adversary.
E.
अ neg. विपक्ष an adversary.

m. (-टः)
Wollen cloth.
E.
अवि a sheep, and पटच् aff.

f. (-पत्)
Prosperity, ease.
E.
अ neg. विपद् misfortune.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Uninjured, unhurt.
2 Not soiled or contaminated, pure, clean.
E.
अ neg. विपन्न destroyed.

mfn. (-श्चित्)
Unwise, ignorant.
E.
अ neg. विपश्चिद् learned.

m. (-कः)
1 Immaturity.
2 Not suffering the consequence of actions in a former life.
3 Indigestion.
E.
अ neg. विपाक ripening.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Small, insignificant, slender.
E.
अ neg. विपुल large.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Near, not remote.
E.
अ neg. विप्रकृष्ट remote.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Undeviating, following or observing steadily.
2 Observed, unviolated.
E.
अ neg. विप्लुत transgressed.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Fruitful, productive.
E.
अ neg. विफल unfruitful.

mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
Unblown.
E.
अ neg. विफुल्ल blown.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Undivided, unpartitioned.
2 Joint, unseparated, (as coparceners.)
E.
अ neg. विभक्त divided.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Unportioned, unpartitioned.
m. (-गः)
Undivided inheritance.
E.
अ neg. विभाग division.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
1 One who does not share.
2 Not sharing, not dividing.
E.
अ neg. विभागिन् who divides.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
Not to be divided, not to be partitioned.
E.
अ neg. विभाज्य particle^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-त्वं)
Indivisibility, unfitness for partition.
E.
अविभाज्य and त्व affix; also with तल्, अविभाज्यता.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Disappearance, imperceptibility.
E.
अ neg. विभावन perception.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Imperceptible, undistinguishable.
E.
अ neg. विभावनीय.

n. (-सं)
The milk of a ewe.
E.
अवि and मरीसच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Foul, turbid.
E.
अ neg. विमल clear.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Unloosed, not quitted.

A name of Benares.
E.
अ neg. and विमुक्त loosed: the last is never to be lost view of by those seeking salvation.

m. (-रः)
A celebrated Śiva Liṅga, at Benares.
E.
अविमुक्त, and ईश्वर lord.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Undivided, conjoined.
2 Not separated or absent.
E.
अ neg. वियुक्त disjoined.

m. (-गः)
1 Conjunction, association.
2 Presence, not being parted or absent.
E.
अ neg. वियोग disunion.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Interested in, attached to.
E.
अ neg. विरक्त unattached.

adj. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Eternal, continual, uninterrupted.
2 Abandoned, or
adv. n. (-तं)
Eternal, continual.
E.
अ neg. विरत, stopping.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Coarse, gross, substantial.
2 Close, contiguous.
3 Uninterrupted.
E.
अ neg. and विरल fine.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Continuous, uninterrupted.
m. (-मः)
Continuance, Uninterrupted succession.
n. adv. (-मं)
Uninterruptedly.
E.
अ neg. विराम rest.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Unimpeded, unobstructed.
2 Allowed, permitted, proper.
3 Compatible, consistent with.
E.
अ neg. विरुद्ध hindered.

n. (-नं)
Constipating, stopping dejection.
E.
अ neg. विरेचन purging.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
Improper to be purged.
E.
अ neg. विरेच्य to be purged.

m. (-धः)
1 Absence of impediment.
2 Assent, concurrence, non-opposition.
3 Consistency, compatibility.
E.
अ neg. विरोध hindrance.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unimpeded, unobstructed.
E.
अ neg. विरोधित hindered.

n. (-नं)
Not exceeding, not trespassing.
E.
अ neg. विलङ्घन trespassing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Prescribed, fixed, not to be transgressed or exceeded.
E.
अ neg. विलङ्घनीय to be passed over or beyond.

mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
Prompt, quick, without delay.
E.
अ neg. विलम्ब delay.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Quick, expeditious: also अविलम्बित.

mfn. adj. (-तः-ता-तं)
Quick, expeditious.
n. adv. (-तं)
Quickly, expeditiously.
E.
अ neg. and विलम्बित slow, tedious.

m. (-मः)
Going quickly, a swift pace.
E.
अविलम्बित and क्रम motion.

f. (-ला)
A sheep, a ewe.
E.
अ neg. विल to break, अच् and टाप् affixes; not able to wound, &c. having no horns.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Foul, turbid.
E.
आङ्, विल to break, and क aff.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Faithful, constant.
E.
अ neg. विलास sport, caprice.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unasserted, undeclared.
E.
अ neg. विवक्षित said.

m. (-दः)
Concurrence, consent, non-disagreement.
E.
अ neg. विवाद dispute.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Quiet, peaceable.
E.
अ neg. विवादिन् contentious.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unmarried.
E.
अ and विवाहित.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
1 Interdicted as to marriage.
2 Not relating to marriage.
3 Single, not marrying.
E.
अ neg. विवाहिन् marrying.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Uninvestigated, undiscriminated.
2 Indiscriminate, confounded.
3 Common, public.
E.
अ neg. विविक्त discriminated.

m. (-कः)
Ignorance, absence of discrimination or judgment.
E.
अ neg. and विवेक discrimination.

f. (-ता)
Inconsiderateness, imprudence, want of judgment.
E.
अविवेक and तल् added: also अविवेकत्वं.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Ignorant, undiscriminating, defective in judgment, superficial, short sighted.
E.
अविवेक as above, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Ignorant, undiscriminating.
E.
अ, and विवेचक who judges.

f. (-ना)
Want of judgment.
E.
अ neg. विवेचन discriminating.

f. (-ङ्का)
Unapprehensiveness, confidence, certainty.
E.
अ neg. विशङ्का fear.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Confiding, trusting, unapprehensive.
E.
अ neg. विशङ्कित alarmed.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Pure, clear, free from fault or defect.
2 Valid, perfect, unimpeached.
E.
अ neg. विशुद्ध faulty.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Uniform, alike, without any difference.
n. (-षं)
Equality, uniformity.
E.
अ neg. विशेष variation.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Indiscriminating, not perceiving the difference in things.
E.
अ neg. विशेष, and ज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Unwearied.
E.
अ neg. विश्रान्त tired.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Suspected, doubted, not trusted.
E.
अ, and विश्वस्त trusted.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Mistrusted.
m. (-सः)
Suspicion, mistrust.
E.
अ neg. विश्वास trust.

f. (-सा)
A cow calving after long intervals.
E.
अ neg. विश्वास trust.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Mistrustful, unbelieving.
E.
अ neg. विश्वासिन् who trusts.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Anti-venomous, antidote, not poisonous.
E.
अ neg. and विष poison.
m. (-षः)
The ocean, sky.
f. (-षी)
1 A river.
2 The earth.
3 Heaven.
E.
अव to go, &c. टिषच Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Unchecked, unopposed, unimpeded.
E.
अ neg. विषक्त restrained.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Unperceived, invisible.
2 Insensible, disregarding objects of sense.
m. (-यः)
1 Disappearance, absence.
2 Disregard of objects of sense.
E.
अ neg. विषय an object of sense.

m. (-विः)
An extender or enlarger.

ind.
Manifest, evident.
E.
आङ्, उङ् to sound, इर् aff.

mfn. (र्गी-र्गिणी-र्गि)
Adhering to, retaining, not quitting.
m. (-र्गी)
A continued fever.
E.
अ neg. विसर्गिन quitting.

n. (-ढं)
Ewe's milk.
E.
अवि and सोढ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Compact, compressed, close.
E.
अ neg. विस्तृत spread.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Obscure, not clear or plain.
n. (-ष्टं)
Indistinct speech.
E.
अ neg. विस्पष्ट plain.

n. (-णं)
Remembering, not forgetting.
E.
अ neg. विस्मरण forgetting.

f. (-तिः)
Remembering, recollection.
E.
अ neg. विस्मृति forgetfulness.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Undone, uneffected.
2 Unprescribed, not directed or ruled.
E.
अ neg. विहित established.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Calm, composed, unagitated.
E.
अ neg. विह्नल agitated.

n. (-णं)
Not regarding, not looking at.
E.
अ neg. वीक्षण seeing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unseen, unbeheld.
E.
अ neg. वीक्षित seen.

m. (-चिः)
A hell.
mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि)
Waveless.
E.
अ neg. वीचि a wave.

m. (-यः)
A hell, the place of punishment for liars.
E.
अवीचि without waves, मयट् aff.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Seedless.
n. (जं)
Bad seed.
2 Absence of seed.
E.
अ neg. वीज seed.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Seedless.
E.
अवीज and कन् added.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Weak, impotent, helpless.
f. (-रा)
A woman who has neither husband nor son.
E.
अ neg. वीर strong.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Made of woollen thread.
E.
आविक and सूत्र a thread, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Pierced, wounded.
2 Crooked.
3 Cast, thrown, sent.
4 Disappointed.
5 Stupid, foolish.
E.
आङ् before व्यध to hurt, क्त aff.

f. (-र्णीं)
A plant, (Aknidhi): also आविद्धकर्णिका f. (-का.)

m. (-धः)
An awl, a drill, a kind of gimblet worked by a string.
E.
आङ्, व्यध to pierce, घञ् or क aff.

m. (-वः)
Manifestation, presence, becoming visible.
E.
आविस् manifestly, and भाव condition.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Appeared, manifest, become visible.
E.
आविस् and भूत become.

n. (-णं)
Manifestation, making visible.
E.
आविस् an करण making.

m. (-रः)

E.
आविस् and कार making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made or become visible, evident, manifest.
E.
आविस् apparent, and कृत made.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)

E.

m. (-ती)

E.
